open-sea.what: Open sea off the spawn island, temperate (latitude 47°): ocean 128 blocks all round, seabed at y28, about 80 m deep. The island lies to the west.

shallows.what: A sand flat under 1 m of water on the spawn island's west shore, temperate (47°). The bed shelves west: 4 m at x -108, 5 m at -112, 7 m at -120, 11 m at -132. A sand beach rises to the east.

beach.what: The build site: a sand spit in a calm freshwater lagoon, subtropical and wet (30°, about 21 °C in spring), its sand flush with the water at y109 from x -3312 to -3292 and z 9840 to 9844, so a vessel laid on it lies by the water, as the dugout asks. Water a metre deep all round, with lily pads; a birch stands at -3306 9843, the builds go east of it.

lagoon.what: Open water in the beach zone's lagoon, just south of its sand spit: a vessel afloat on calm fresh water with the spit, its birch and the reeds behind her, for the wiki's afloat pictures.

current.what: A cold boundary current running south at 0.5 m/s along a western shore (52°), water about 1 °C, 15 m deep. Land lies to the west.

cold-shore.what: A forested shore at 60°, sea to the east, water below 0 °C; spring days near freezing.

lake-shore.what: The south shore of the big freshwater lake the beach zone's spit lies in (still water at y109, 6 m deep, 29 km of fetch): reedy soil flush with the water to the south, for surf on fresh water. A gale staged 300 blocks east (/seas stage gale 24 600 at -3073 10017) blows across the lake onto it.

gentle-beach.what: A flat sand beach flush with the open sea on the spawn island's east coast (47°), the sea to the east, its shoreface dropping a metre a block; a calm lagoon lies behind it. For surf and the band on a gentle beach: a gale staged 300 blocks south (/seas stage gale 24 600 at 168 237) blows onshore.

steep-shore.what: The steepest sand-footed shore of the open sea near spawn, on the island east of it (47°): a strip of sand at the water, then grassy soil climbing a block a block (sea to the south, ground 0 1 2 3 4 6 blocks over it). For surf on a steep shore: a gale staged 300 blocks west (/seas stage gale 24 600 at 376 -87) blows onshore.
